color.note: Dark is the primary theme and the fallback. Graphite is the ground, ink is the text, cadmium is the brand and means local; cherenkov is reserved for Kadmium Cloud. Every text token's note names the grounds it holds 4.5:1 on, in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Inputs sit on it inside cards. Dark is the primary theme; light is for docs and marketing pages only.

tokens.name: graphite-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, the sidebar, menus, the node tiles of the topology view.

tokens.name: graphite-2
tokens.usage: Wells and hover: code blocks, table header rows, hover on quiet controls, meter tracks.

tokens.name: graphite-3
tokens.usage: Pressed states, scrollbar thumbs, the darkest well inside a graphite-2 area.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and table borders, dividers. Decorative — it is not required to meet 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that carry meaning: inputs, quiet buttons, checkboxes. 3:1 on graphite-0 and graphite-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on graphite-0, graphite-1, graphite-2 and graphite-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hardware lines, metadata, table captions, tab labels at rest. 4.5:1 on all four graphite surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only — about 3:1 on graphite-0 and graphite-1; never for information a person must read.

tokens.name: cadmium
tokens.usage: The brand fill: primary buttons, the rods in the mark, active tab bars, local-node meters, selected states. Always with on-cadmium on top. Cadmium means local, self-hosted, the open-source core.

tokens.name: cadmium-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted cadmium.

tokens.name: cadmium-text
tokens.usage: Cadmium as TEXT, icon or border: links, the shell prompt, local badges, the active tab label, the focus ring. 4.5:1 on all graphite surfaces and on cadmium-soft in both themes — in light it is the dark gold, never the fill yellow.

tokens.name: on-cadmium
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cadmium or cadmium-hover fill: the primary button label, the cadmium app tile. Never white on yellow.

tokens.name: cadmium-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cadmium-text: the local badge, selected rows, a highlighted shard range.

tokens.name: cadmium-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px border of anything filled cadmium (primary button, local meter fill). Invisible in dark (it equals the fill); in light it is the darker gold that keeps a yellow control at 3:1 against white.

tokens.name: cherenkov
tokens.usage: The cloud fill: Kadmium Cloud buttons, burst-node meters, cloud shards in the shard rail. Reserved for managed, rented or remote compute — never a second decorative accent. With on-cherenkov on top.

tokens.name: cherenkov-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted cherenkov.

tokens.name: cherenkov-text
tokens.usage: Cherenkov as text, icon or border: cloud badges, cloud links, numbers in code. 4.5:1 on all graphite surfaces and on cherenkov-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: on-cherenkov
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cherenkov or cherenkov-hover fill (the Cloud button label). Dark ink in the dark theme, white in light.

tokens.name: cherenkov-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cherenkov-text: the cloud badge, a cloud row in the topology table.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success, resident, verified, in-sync — as text, icon or small fill. A teal, not a green, so it is never confused with danger by hue alone. 4.5:1 on the graphite surfaces and ok-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning, degraded, yielded (gaming mode), spot-eviction notice. Always with a word or the alert icon — orange sits near cadmium, so color alone must never carry it. 4.5:1 on the graphite surfaces and warn-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warn text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure, offline, corrupted shard, destructive actions. 4.5:1 on the graphite surfaces and danger-soft in both themes; at least 3:1 lighter or darker than ok.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text and the danger button.

tokens.name: tier-hot
tokens.usage: Hot tier: weights resident in VRAM or unified memory. Fill for stacked tier bars and topology cells; same hue as cadmium, full strength.

tokens.name: tier-warm
tokens.usage: Warm tier: experts held in system RAM. The same yellow, dimmed (dark) or paled (light) — tiers are told apart by lightness, never by a new hue.

tokens.name: tier-cold
tokens.usage: Cold tier: experts streamed from NVMe or the NAS. The faintest step; label it, since it sits close to the graphite ground.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, flags and the shell prompt in code blocks.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: String literals and paths in code blocks.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, units and model names in code blocks.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments and line numbers in code blocks.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at 650: a grotesk with the slightly rounded, industrial cut that matches the rod ends. Tight tracking; no italic in the system.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero line of a marketing page or the cover. One per page.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Every machine you own, as one reactor
styles.usage: Page titles on marketing and docs pages.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headings; the plan card's name; dashboard page titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, the node name on a node card.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo at 400 and 600. Body is 15px — the dashboard is dense, so it never goes smaller than caption.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Cadmium turns any heterogeneous collection of devices into one self-balancing AI/ML supercomputer.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs on docs and marketing pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Relief nodes prefetch static base weights from the NAS before the handoff.
styles.usage: Everything by default: paragraphs, table cells, form labels' values, button labels at 600.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, button labels, tab labels when active.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Fails back to local hardware as soon as the node recovers.
styles.usage: Help text, input hints, footnotes, timestamps in prose. The smallest sans size.

groups.name: Data and code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono carries every number, identifier, path, hostname and command. Labels are uppercase with wide tracking — the instrument-panel voice.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, badges, meter labels, table headers, axis ticks. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS; the style carries the tracking.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The big number on a stat tile or plan card. Use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, the hardware line on a node card, inline code, shard ranges, hostnames and ports.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Dense tables and the topology view, where code would not fit.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. The rod pitch — the distance between rods in the mark, the pattern and the shard rail — is space-6 (24px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; the gap between a badge dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and small controls; between stacked meters' label and track.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; horizontal padding of small buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; horizontal padding of medium buttons; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards and dialog bodies.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a panel; the rod pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels; page gutters on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section spacing on docs pages.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections.

radius.note: Square-shouldered with soft corners. Rods and pills are the only fully round things.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Meter tracks and fills, checkboxes, the active-tab bar, code spans.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, popovers, the plan card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, hero panels, the topology canvas.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: App tiles and avatars of the node tiles — the YY family tile corner (26px at 120px). A percentage so it scales with the tile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, pills, rod ends, status dots.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly borders on the dark ground; shadows are tight and nearly black. The focus ring is a shadow so it follows every radius.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and inputs at rest, with a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts — anything floating. Includes the hairline, so a floating surface never needs its own border.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid cadmium-text (above 3:1 on every surface in both themes). Apply on :focus-visible only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs inside tables and card headers.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero and plan-card calls to action; touch targets.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons inside medium buttons and inputs; the node-type icon on a node card.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons in navigation and the topology view — the size the icon set is drawn at.
